NFA Tree Lab

How it works

Each row consumes one input symbol, shown under “Symbol read.” Nodes show state names.

ε-moves consume nothing. Each ε-move has its own labeled arrow between states on the same row, including before the first symbol or after the last.

Double circles mark accepting configurations after all input is consumed. You may stop there even if an ε-move is also available. Bold paths lead to these endpoints.

Click a node to see its path, including every individual ε-move. Branches stop when no next symbol can be consumed.
